brief.t: START HERE: Call Aaron and Evelyn, with Sam looped in, to reconcile both Silk Factor lots and actual shipments before further fulfillment.

ACT NOW 1: Silk Factor — discrepancy 12 days old. Luke signed; microbial results, batch records, dates and lot-specific shipment traceability remain unresolved. Send internally: Aaron, Evelyn and Ron, reconcile both lots, shipments, microbial results and batch records with Sam today, then document authorized disposition before further fulfillment.

ACT NOW 2: Roon — six days to the requested December 1 run. A new one-week dispensing test started today cannot finish before December 1. Three refund reports include one off smell—not confirmed contamination; materials remain in QC. Send internally: Ron, Aaron and Evelyn, review affected lots and complaints with Sam today, verify when the approved R7 dispensing test actually started, and reconcile the full-week test and QC holds before any December 1 commitment.

ACT NOW 3: Hunter — yesterday’s audit outcome unverified. Audit date was November 24; first status was due November 20 at 4 PM, five calendar days ago. Planned installation is not commissioning or release. Send internally: Ron and Evelyn, confirm whether yesterday’s audit occurred and record findings, master-1138 gaps, owners and recovery dates today; I’ll provide actual approved-document and resource status without backdating.
